attchmntText: Bonfiglioli Transmissions Limited has informed the Exchange about
voiceSummary: Bonfiglioli Transmissions Limited has uploaded the audio recording of its Q3CY26 Earnings Conference Call to its website. The call covered financial results for the quarter and nine months ended September 30, 2026. This disclosure is made under Regulation 30 of SEBI Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements Regulations, 2015. The company previously informed the exchanges on November 06, 2026, regarding the scheduled call. The recording is now available for public access via the link provided in the original correspondence. This filing serves as an informational update for BSE Limited and National Stock Exchange of India Limited. Sunil Kumar, Company Secretary and Compliance Officer, signed the letter dated November 13, 2026.
